params.prompt: EDIT IMAGE 1, a packshot of an open cluster ring on a cream plaster cube. Make ONE change only: the gold BAND becomes BROAD and HEAVY, about 5 to 6mm wide and about 2mm thick, a solid wide band like a cigar band, as IMAGE 2 (the owner's photo of the ring worn on a finger) shows, with each open end squared off into a thick gold block under its cluster. Keep everything else in IMAGE 1 exactly as it is: the four clear stones (one small round and one pear on one end, two pears with their points turned outward on the other), their claws, their positions and their sizes, the row of tiny gold beads, the cube, the camera, the framing, the background and the light. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. The picture runs edge to edge as a crisp, clean, modern digital studio photograph, shot today on a high-resolution digital camera.
